paper_title: Axion Dark Matter eXperiment around 3.3 μeV with Dine-Fischler-Srednicki-Zhitnitsky Discovery Ability
suggested_experiment_name: ADMX (Axion Dark Matter eXperiment) 2022 run around 3.3 μeV
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, canonical axion-photon coupling
notes: Paper reports exclusion of DFSZ axions with masses 3.27–3.34 μeV at 90% CL. The coupling g_agamma is the axion-photon coupling constant. Figure 4 shows the exclusion limits as a function of frequency/mass; the limits are approximately flat across this narrow mass range at ~1.5×10^-15 GeV^-1 for DFSZ. The experiment assumes a standard halo model with local dark matter density ρ = 0.45 GeV/cm³ composed 100% of axions. The paper distinguishes between exclusion limits (upper bounds on g_agamma) and discovery potential (90% probability of flagging a DFSZ signal).
